title: Typhoon Malakas Impact
message: Shanghai Port operations suspended due to high swell and wind speeds. 12 shipments rerouted via Ningbo.

title: Suez Canal Bottleneck
message: Increased transit wait times detected (average 24h delay). Strategic rerouting via Cape of Good Hope recommended for high-priority cargo.

title: Stockout Risk: Microchips
message: Predictive model suggests 22% risk of raw material shortage in Q3. Recommendation: Diversify suppliers in the ASEAN region.
